dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, gradual narrowing of the 2D profile from the mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform high-intensity mature white across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, dark longitudinal linear mark is present along the central dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A narrow, shadow-casting longitudinal furrow is visible along the central axis of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, straight longitudinal scar or structural indentation along the dorsal midline.
